# FBX material fixtures

**Last updated:** 2026-10-15

Project-authored synthetic cubes, generated by
`python tools/fbx/create_material_fixtures.py`. No downloaded model data is used.

- `diffuse-factor.fbx`: a Phong diffuse-factor image is not a metallic/roughness map.
- `separate-pbr.fbx`: red-channel metallic=0.2 and roughness=0.8 maps. Other channels
  deliberately differ, to detect accidental use as packed B/G channels.
- `scalar-reference.fbx`: the same material expressed as constant factors, for GPU comparison.
- `external/FBX/stale-source-path.fbx`: a stale absolute texture path with its
  image in the sibling `external/Textures/` folder, to test bounded asset-folder
  recovery without embedding an external model in the repository.

The fixture geometry, FBX text and PNG pixels are authored for ArtifactStudio tests
and may be redistributed with the project.
